description: This file defines a Document subclass 'ProjectUpdate' for managing project updates in ERPNext, and includes functions for sending daily reminders and email notifications related to project updates and their statuses.

classes.name: ProjectUpdate
classes.description: A Document subclass representing a project update, primarily serving as a data model without additional methods.

methods.name: daily_reminder()
methods.description: Fetches project data and generates reminder emails for project updates, including draft counts and update summaries.

methods.name: email_sending(project_name,frequency,date_start,date_end,progress,number_of_drafts,update)
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email summarizing project status updates, considering holidays and recipients.
